facts.fact: Le Soleil reports that the government's New Deal Technologique programme provided for the state to acquire 5,000 Starlink kits at a preferential price, among other things to connect schools and collectivités territoriales; no count of local governments is given, and the scheme is undated in the document, so the date is its publication date.
facts.system: kits Starlink acquis par l'État (New Deal Technologique)

facts.fact: Le Soleil reports that the 5,000 Starlink kits meant among other things to connect collectivités territoriales were to be acquired by the state under the government's New Deal Technologique; the scheme is undated in the document, so the date is its publication date.
facts.system: kits Starlink acquis par l'État (New Deal Technologique)

facts.fact: The Supreme Court ordered on 7 September 2026, at Sonatel's suit, the provisional suspension of Starlink Sénégal's licence for fixed satellite internet access, the service whose 5,000 state-acquired kits were meant among other things to connect collectivités territoriales; the document does not say any local government office lost its link.
facts.system: kits Starlink acquis par l'État (New Deal Technologique)
